title: SCHLIEREN VEIL
description: A coupled density/heat/velocity field rendered like high-speed schlieren photography. Buoyant plumes advect and curl through each other while touch injects persistent heat and vorticity into the flow.

visual_finish.material_model: schlieren density-gradient imaging with heat-dependent refractive colour
